caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular wooden chest with a slightly curved lid, colored primarily in dark brown and black tones. The front panel of the chest is decorated with colorful floral motifs and a central bird figure. The bird, facing to the right, has shades of pink, red, and light brown, with detailed wings and a tail that extends to the left. Surrounding the bird are several flowers and leaves in various colors, including red, pink, white, yellow, green, and orange. The flowers feature different shapes and arrangements, and the leaves are elongated and multi-toned. There is a multicolored border (composed of diagonal stripes in red, green, white, and orange) framing the decorated front panel. The chest's lid is simply painted with abstract patterns and muted colors, mainly shades of black, green, and pink. The background of the drawing itself is an off-white color with some small brown marks on the right side.
title: Native Pine Box
